verdict.rationale: CHKit lets users and agents define schema and pipelines as code and validate, test, and deploy them in CI, with a reviewable diff, which covers versioning and review. Rolling back automations is not documented: point-in-time recovery and time travel restore database data, an adjacent feature rather than reverting a pipeline or automation definition. missing for 10: documented rollback of pipeline/automation deployments, explicit version history for automations (e.g. alert rules, refreshable views), independent or hands-on corroboration of CHKit workflows.
